result.command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== ZBAR POLICY ==='
apt-cache policy zbar-tools || true
echo '=== ZBAR SHOW ==='
apt-cache show zbar-tools 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,80p' || true
echo '=== SEARCH BAR CODE ==='
apt-cache search 'bar code' | grep -i -E 'zbar|bar code|barcode' | tail -n 60 || true
echo '=== SEARCH DECODE ==='
apt-cache search decode | grep -i -E 'zbar|bar code|barcode' | tail -n 60 || true

Description-en: QR code / bar code scanner and decoder (utilities)
 ZBar is a library for scanning and decoding bar codes from various sources
 such as video streams, image files or raw intensity sensors. It supports
 EAN-13/UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-8, Code 128, Code 39, Interleaved 2 of 5 and QR Code.
 .

 and using a video4linux device (e.g. webcam) as a bar code scanner.
